data.text: In the MANUS armor system, Lance has very powerful attacks best suited to intense, up-close combat. \nHis power slash special attack can break through some types of doors.
In the CORUS armor system, Ilana becomes a fast and versatile combatant with long-range attacks. \nHer electrostatic shield special attack can both protect her and damage her enemies.
You can't go further until you rescue all humans!
Lance! I activated my electrostatic shield to stop these Mutraddi beasts, but there are too many of them!
I’ll take care of it, Princess Ilana!
Go ahead, Princess! I’ll try to hold them off for you.
Thanks, Lance. I’ll help you out!
I don't think you can break those doors, Ilana. \nUse your jump thrusters to look for another way around.
It's a trap! Quick, take them out!
You can destroy these doors, Lance. \n "Z" to use your power slash special attack.
Looks like you are too big to fit through here, Lance. \n Maybe Ilana would be small enough.
You won't fit through that hole, Lance. \nOnly Ilana can fit through them.
You can fit through these holes, Ilana.
You can fit through these holes, Ilana, \nUse your electrostatic shield to pass through flames.
This place is collapsing! We must get Ilana out of here! Hurry, Lance!
This place is collapsing! We must reach the escape ship immediately. Hurry, princess!
While standing in front of a door, \npress “down arrow” to enter buildings.
Those dirty Mutraddi beasts are threatening Earthlings! \n Let's take them out!
Earthlings are in danger. \nWe must help them!
A rift gate has been opened. \nGeneral Modula is sending his beasts to get Ilana. \nWe must regroup at the bottom of this building!
A rift gate has been opened. \nGeneral Modula is sending his beasts to get you, Ilana. \nWe must regroup at the bottom of this building!
\nSym-bionic defense mode initiated. Octus unit, MAGNIFY!
That Mutraddi Mega-Beast is too strong, even for my MANUS armor. \nWe need to find another way to stop it.
We can’t defeat that Mutraddi Mega-Beast. It’s too powerful! There must be another way. The Earthlings are depending on us!
Mutraddi Mega-Beast located. Engaging battle. \nThe Titan can cover himself by pressing the "down arrow".
\nAttacking us? We're trying to help them!
\nYou can’t pass through these doors, Ilana.
\nYour MANUS armor can break cracked doors by touching them.
